QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_25

question.text: The OECD DAC evaluation criteria, widely used in development-programme evaluation, include which of the following standard set?

answer.text: Relevance, Coherence, Effectiveness, Efficiency, Impact, Sustainability

explanation.text: The Logic: OECD DAC evaluation criteria (updated 2019) are: Relevance, Coherence, Effectiveness, Efficiency, Impact, Sustainability. The original 1991 set had five; coherence was added in 2019. These criteria structure development programme evaluations globally. The Trap: Option 2 is financial-analysis jargon. Option 3 is POSDCORB (management). Option 4 is marketing funnel. Only the DAC set fits development evaluation. Cross-Exam Context: X-A IA policy-evaluation and V-B MF Foundation both reference DAC criteria. XXIII expects exact naming. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Structure your SAS-100 engagement letter around the six DAC criteria as a top-level outline — it gives both you and the SE a shared scaffolding and makes the SIR/AIR read cleanly for international readers.
